promotion_pipeline.policy: sequential evidence gates and explicit human approval; no execution authority

self_improvement.interpretation: operational learning index; not a measure of general intelligence

evaluation.void_verdict: VOID — this window cannot produce a usable out-of-sample result and will not be cited as one

criteria.primary: net-of-fees return beats buy-and-hold BTC over the window
criteria.quality: positive Sharpe on the equity curve
criteria.minimum_sample: at least 30 closed trades, else the result is not significant

hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: The majority of crypto signals are flat or modestly long with negligible volatility and zero alpha, while the core assets (BTC, ETH, SOL, LTC) show negative composites, modest to high expected shortfall, and mixed institutional factor scores. Liquidity concerns for SOL and LTC further erode confidence. Although the cross‑asset regime is labeled risk_on, the internal risk metrics suggest a cautious stance. We therefore tilt to risk_off, scaling down overall exposure and nudging convictions downward on the more fragile symbols.

shadow_evaluation.promotion_policy: manual approval required; shadow evidence cannot arm live trading
